newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 19.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will most likely be re-elected Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) president.
-- Former Prime Minister Morihiro Hosokawa quits main opposition party Shinshinto (New Frontier Party).
-- China allows Hong Kong to participate in APEC and WTO.
-- Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co's liquidation plan settled.
-- Hideo Sakamaki, former president of Nomura Securities Co Ltd, suspected of agreeing to provide 49.7 million yen payoff to corporate racketeer Ryuichi Koike.
-- Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp plans to set up unit in Malaysia.
